message: Relation field "User.favorites" is an implicit many-to-many relation whose junction model would be named "Favorites", but model "Favorites" already has that name. Rename model "Favorites" and keep its table with @@map("Favorites"); Prisma 7's next migration is then empty.

Relation field "Post.tags" is an implicit many-to-many relation whose junction model would be named "PostToTag", but model "PostToTag" already has that name. Rename model "PostToTag" and keep its table with @@map("PostToTag"); Prisma 7's next migration is then empty.
